name: DonutShop v0.7.22
body:
- **"Experimental Firmware stage/flash" now 3.3x faster**. Majority of process now happens in client browser vs on Nano. Falls back to previous Nano-based methods if browser-direct fails.
  - Stage + Flash comparison
    - Previously (v0.7.21) = 2m 40s
    - Now only **54s**
- All Options persist regardless of client viewing WebCtl. (Experimental Firmware Test Mode used to be session based)
- Removed redundant confirmation when doing a manual fwup go.
